# Velora Automations

> Velora Automations designs practical AI automation systems for small and mid-sized businesses in the United States and Canada. Services include AI receptionists, lead qualification, appointment automation, customer support, follow-up automation, CRM automation, and workflow automation.

## Core Solutions

- [AI Receptionist](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/ai-receptionist): Handles approved routine inquiries, captures context, routes requests, and supports human handoff.
- [Lead Qualification](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/lead-qualification): Collects required information and routes qualified, incomplete, or uncertain inquiries using defined business rules.
- [Appointment Automation](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/appointment-automation): Coordinates eligibility, real calendar availability, booking, reminders, and exceptions.
- [Customer Support](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/customer-support): Answers from approved knowledge, categorizes requests, and escalates cases that need a person.
- [Follow-Up Automation](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/follow-up-automation): Supports consent-aware follow-up for missed calls, leads, quotes, reminders, and post-consultation actions.
- [CRM Automation](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/crm-automation): Maps approved details, statuses, notes, owners, and tasks into compatible CRM workflows.
- [Workflow Automation](https://www.veloraautomations.com/solutions/workflow-automation): Connects validation, classification, system actions, notifications, approvals, and failure handling.

- [Example Workflows](https://www.veloraautomations.com/resources/workflows): Illustrative workflow structures, not customer case studies.
- [Integrations](https://www.veloraautomations.com/resources/integrations): Requirements for connecting compatible business systems.
- [Security and Control](https://www.veloraautomations.com/resources/security): Deployment-specific permissions, data handling, monitoring, and escalation considerations.
- [Opportunity Calculator](https://www.veloraautomations.com/resources/calculator): A planning model based on visitor inputs, not a forecast.
- [FAQ](https://www.veloraautomations.com/resources/faq): Direct answers about scope, pricing, timelines, integrations, and human control.
